content:
ben-release: Quick heads up — planning to push runtime v2.11.0, api v1.9.6, router v3.4.1 during the 00:30 UTC change window tonight. Console needs a schema bump (minor) to read the new runtime metrics.
carla-runtime: Noted. runtime change includes kernel-batching toggle behind feature flag. We'll default it OFF for the first wave.
erik-router: Router side is compatible with 3.4.1 but requires the header-split flag to be present in requests. Can console guarantee it for the rollout?
dana-console: We can add header-split in the UI and API proxy. Will submit a tiny PR to set the header for canary routes. ETA 45m.
alice-eng: We should pin API to v1.9.6 for the first 25% traffic slice. If runtime sees elevated latency or 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m, we rollback runtime only. Agree? :eyes:
carla-runtime: Agree with the rollback threshold. Also propose adding a KV-eviction guard: if mem pressure > 85% then temporarily disable batching.
erik-router: Router team will watch connection churn. If we see >2% connection resets in 10m, we will pin the router back to 3.3.x.
dana-console: PR open: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4234 — sets header-split for canary routes and toggles display. Deploy preview up.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by ben-release for 00:30 UTC. Waves: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Canary watchers: carla-runtime, erik-router, dana-console.
ben-release: Runbook notes: annotate release notes with the kernel-batching flag and header-split requirement. Also call out that console will set header for canary.
alice-eng: For pinning, please use the deploy-bot pin command before the 00:30 wave: `/deploy pin api@v1.9.6 runtime@v2.11.0 router@3.4.1 --note "canary pin for 00:30 window"`
deploy-bot: Command queued: `/deploy pin api@v1.9.6 runtime@v2.11.0 router@3.4.1`. Please confirm with a :thumbsup: to proceed.
carla-runtime: :thumbsup:
erik-router: :thumbsup:
dana-console: :thumbsup:
alice-eng: One more thing — if runtime telemetry shows regen latency regression > 10% for 5m, we rollback runtime and unpin API/router (they remain safe). Ben, please be ready to trigger `rollback runtime` quickly.
ben-release: Got it. I'll monitor the first two waves and stand by for rollback. I'll also post a concise release note in #release-notes when 100% completes.
deploy-bot: Canary wave 1 (10%) started at 00:30:35 UTC. Monitoring hooks enabled: latency, 5xx, connection resets, mem pressure.
carla-runtime: Seeing expected latency baseline +2%. Watching KV pressure.
erik-router: No abnormal resets so far.
dana-console: Console canary shows header present, no schema errors.
ben-release: If anyone needs to abort, call out now. Otherwise we proceed to 25% at +7m.
alice-eng: Proceed.
deploy-bot: Wave 2 (25%) started at 00:37:50 UTC.
carla-runtime: Jump to 25% looks fine. Mem at 62%. No eviction guard triggered.
erik-router: Router metrics steady.
deploy-bot: Wave 3 (50%) started at 00:45:10 UTC.
carla-runtime: At 50% we see regen p50 +8%, p95 +12% vs baseline. Regression alert triggered but not exceeding rollback threshold yet.
alice-eng: Keep an eye — if p95 crosses +15% or 5xx >0.5% for 5m we rollback.
ben-release: Roger. Holding for 5m before final 100% push.
deploy-bot: No rollback triggered. Wave 4 (100%) started at 00:52:30 UTC.
dana-console: Console note: updated release notes snippet in PR description.
ben-release: 100% complete. Posting release note now. Thanks all for quick responses. :tada:
